blocks.x: Let's see, I made some notes here. When we were talking about Princess Belle, did you remember what her last name was?
Oh, her last name was Belle.
Oh, I didn't fully understand that before.
Sure. She's a friend of Susie's. Her last name was Belle.
And she was a fine pianist, a very fine pianist, wasn't she?
Well, I just heard about her.
I didn't get a chance to hear her.
